proposal.description: strike_counter counts a strike when the hiccup cool-down finishes (hiccup_done) instead of when S_HICCUP is entered
proposal.reason: Each strike now lands at the end of its cool-down. hiccup_timer therefore times every cool-down at the previous strike level: 5 ms instead of 10 ms for the first hiccup, 10 ms instead of 20 ms for the second, so En comes back early. latch_out also asserts at the end of the third cool-down instead of on entry to it, and a hiccup cut short by a hard fault counts no strike at all.

proposal.description: The SCR latch read-back debouncer is copied from the enable-switch instance, so it gets the symmetric 20 ms switch qualification instead of the fault-flag default of 1 ms assert and 200 us release
proposal.reason: Suppose the analog OVP sets the SCR latch, so latch_stat goes high while latch_out stays low. The supervisor, Red_LED1 and the STATUS latch bit now see it only after 20 ms instead of 1 ms, so En stays high and the FSM stays in S_SS/S_RUN for about 19 ms longer. A cleared latch also takes 20 ms instead of 200 us to release.

proposal.description: The OTP debouncer is copied from the SPI glitch filters, so over-temperature is qualified in 8 clocks (160 ns) both ways instead of the fault-flag 1 ms assert and 200 us release
proposal.reason: An OTP_trig pulse longer than 8 clocks but shorter than 1 ms now drives the supervisor to S_OFF and pulls En low, and it lights Red_LED2. The correct design ignores such a pulse. After a real over-temperature, OTP also clears 160 ns after the comparator drops instead of 200 us later.
